question: Explain the techniques a company can use to hedge foreign exchange risk.

points.label: Forward contracts
points.description: A forward contract fixes the exchange rate today for a transaction on a future date.

points.label: Currency futures
points.description: Standardised exchange-traded contracts to buy or sell currency at a future date, settled daily (marked to market).

points.label: Currency options
points.description: Give the right but not the obligation to buy or sell currency at a set rate, protecting against losses while keeping upside, for a premium.

points.label: Money market hedge
points.description: Borrowing and investing in the two currencies to create an offsetting position.

points.label: Swaps and internal techniques
points.description: Currency swaps, and internal techniques such as leading and lagging, netting, matching and invoicing in the home currency.
